Diagnosis.submission: Root cause found in social-graph-service. Its GetFollowers RPC fails with a client-side Redis error ("ZADD: no key specified" logged at SocialGraphHandler.h:607), even for valid existing users. This cascades: home-timeline-service logs "Failed to get followers from social-network-service" (HomeTimelineHandler.h:129), and compose-post-service logs "Failed to write home timeline to home-timeline-service" (ComposePostHandler.h:530), causing nginx-thrift POST /wrk2-api/post/compose to return HTTP 500 (TTransportException). Redis itself was healthy (only valid ZRANGE calls, zero error replies), so the fault was a stuck/bad state in social-graph-service. Mitigation applied: rollout restart of social-graph-service, home-timeline-service, and compose-post-service; compose posts now return "Successfully upload post" and the downstream errors have stopped.
